topics.title: Plants
topics.description: Discover the world of plants around us!

lessons.title: Types of Plants
lessons.hook: Did you know plants come in many different sizes? Some are tiny, some are HUGE! 🌳
lessons.explanation: Plants can be very big or very small. We divide them into different groups based on their size and the type of stem they have. Let's explore!
lessons.content:
There are 5 main types of plants:

1. **Trees** - Very big and tall with hard, brown stems called trunks. They live for many years!
2. **Shrubs** - Medium-sized plants with strong woody stems
3. **Herbs** - Small plants with soft green stems
4. **Climbers** - Weak plants that need support to grow up
5. **Creepers** - Weak plants that grow along the ground

lessons.title: Parts of a Plant
lessons.hook: Every plant is like a small factory with special parts that do different jobs! 🏭
lessons.explanation: Plants have many parts, and each part has an important job to help the plant grow and survive.
lessons.content:
The main parts of a plant are:

1. **Root** 📍 - Holds plant in soil, absorbs water and minerals
2. **Stem** 🌿 - Carries water and food to all parts, supports the plant
3. **Leaf** 🍃 - Makes food for the plant using air, water, and sunlight
4. **Flower** 💐 - Produces fruits and seeds
5. **Fruit** 🍎 - Contains seeds that grow into new plants

lessons.title: Things We Get From Plants
lessons.hook: Plants give us SO many things we use every day! Let's discover them! 🎁
lessons.explanation: Plants are super useful! They give us food, clothes, medicine, and many other things we need.
lessons.content:
We get many important things from plants:

**Food**: Rice, wheat, vegetables, fruits, spices
**Clothes**: Cotton, jute, linen
**Medicine**: Tulsi, neem, clove
**Other things**: Wood, oil, rubber, paper, perfume, soap

Plants also give us oxygen to breathe!

questions.question: Which of these is a TREE?
questions.explanation: Neem is a tree! Trees are big and tall with hard trunks.

questions.question: What does a ROOT do?
questions.explanation: Roots absorb water and minerals from soil!

questions.question: Which is a SHRUB?
questions.explanation: Rose is a shrub! Shrubs are medium-sized with woody stems.

questions.question: What is the STEM?
options: Green above-ground part that carries water 🌿
questions.explanation: The stem carries water and food to all parts of the plant.

questions.question: Which PLANT part do we EAT as a root?
questions.explanation: Carrot is a root we eat! Spinach is a leaf, apple is a fruit.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECT pair.
questions.hint: What REALLY fixes plant to soil?
questions.explanation: Stem does NOT fix the plant - that's the ROOT's job! Stem carries water.

questions.question: Which plant part do we EAT as a STEM?
questions.explanation: Potato is a stem! It stores food underground.

questions.question: Which plant needs a STICK to grow UP?
questions.explanation: Money plant is a climber! It has weak stems and needs support.

questions.question: We wear clothes made from COTTON. What part is it?
questions.explanation: Cotton comes from the flower! The fluffy fibers are spun into thread.

questions.question: Which part of the plant is BARK?
questions.explanation: Bark is the hard outer skin of tree trunk! It protects the tree.

questions.question: Which is NOT a SPICE?
questions.hint: Spices are used in cooking for flavor.
questions.explanation: Almond is a nut/seed, not a spice! Cinnamon, coriander, and cumin are spices.

questions.question: Which part of plant makes FOOD for the plant?
questions.hint: Green and makes food with sunlight.
questions.explanation: Leaf makes food! It's called the 'kitchen of the plant' because it uses sunlight to make food.

questions.question: Which plant part stores FOOD for later use?
questions.explanation: Potato is a special stem that stores food! This helps the plant survive.

questions.question: What is the function of FLOWERS?
questions.explanation: Flowers make fruits and seeds! Inside fruits are seeds that grow into new plants.

questions.question: Which plant is a CREEPER?
questions.explanation: Pumpkin is a creeper! It spreads along the ground with heavy fruits.

topics.title: Animals
topics.description: Learn about creatures big and small!

lessons.title: Types of Animals
lessons.hook: The world is full of amazing animals! Some walk, some fly, some swim! 🌍
lessons.explanation: Animals are living things that can move around. We can group them by what they eat or where they live.
lessons.content:
Main groups of animals:

1. **Wild Animals** - Live in forests, jungles, and deserts (lion, tiger, bear)
2. **Domestic Animals** - Live with humans (dog, cat, cow)
3. **Birds** - Have wings and can fly (parrot, crow, eagle)
4. **Water Animals** - Live in water (fish, dolphin, crocodile)
5. **Insects** - Tiny creatures with 6 legs (butterfly, bee, ant)

lessons.title: Where Animals Live
lessons.hook: Different animals live in different places! Where would YOU find a fish? 🏜️
lessons.explanation: Animals live in homes called habitats. Each habitat has what the animal needs to survive.
lessons.content:
Different habitats:

1. **Forest** - Trees, shade, wet ground (monkeys, deer, birds)
2. **Desert** - Hot, dry, sandy (camel, snake, scorpion)
3. **Ocean** - Salt water (whale, shark, octopus)
4. **Pond/Lake** - Fresh water (frog, duck, fish)
5. **Mountain** - High, cold (eagle, snow leopard, yak)

topics.title: Food & Nutrition
topics.description: Discover the food we eat and why we need it!

lessons.title: Types of Food
lessons.hook: What's your favorite food? Every food helps your body in a special way! 🍽️
lessons.explanation: We eat different types of food. Each type helps our body in different ways.
lessons.content:
Main food groups:

1. **Fruits & Vegetables** 🥬 - Give us vitamins and energy (apple, carrot, spinach)
2. **Grains & Cereals** 🌾 - Give us energy (rice, wheat, bread)
3. **Protein Foods** 🥚 - Help our body grow (egg, milk, beans)
4. **Healthy Fats** 🥑 - Keep our body warm (nuts, oil)
5. **Sugars & Sweets** 🍪 - Give quick energy (but eat less of these!)

lessons.title: Why We Need Food
lessons.hook: Your body is like a machine! Food is the fuel that keeps it running! ⚡
lessons.explanation: Food gives our body energy and helps it grow, stay healthy, and fight sickness.
lessons.content:
Food helps us:

1. **Grow** - Our bones, muscles, and body need food to get bigger
2. **Get Energy** - We need energy to run, play, study, and think
3. **Stay Healthy** - Food keeps our skin, teeth, and eyes strong
4. **Fight Sickness** - Healthy food helps our body fight germs
5. **Repair** - When we get hurt, food helps our body heal

lessons.title: Body Parts & Functions
lessons.hook: Your body has amazing parts that work together! Let's discover them! 🧠
lessons.explanation: Our body has many parts. Each part does a special job to keep us alive and healthy.
lessons.content:
Main body parts and what they do:

1. **Head** 🧠 - Contains brain (thinking) and eyes (seeing)
2. **Heart** ❤️ - Pumps blood around our body
3. **Lungs** 💨 - Help us breathe air
4. **Stomach** 🍽️ - Digests (breaks down) food
5. **Bones** 🦴 - Give our body shape and support
6. **Muscles** 💪 - Help us move and stay strong

lessons.title: Our Five Senses
lessons.hook: You can see, hear, smell, taste, and touch! These are your superpowers! 👀
lessons.explanation: We have five senses that help us understand the world around us.
lessons.content:
Our five senses:

1. **Sight** 👀 - Eyes let us see colors and shapes
2. **Hearing** 👂 - Ears let us hear sounds
3. **Smell** 👃 - Nose lets us smell things
4. **Taste** 👅 - Tongue lets us taste sweet, sour, salty, bitter
5. **Touch** ✋ - Skin lets us feel hot, cold, soft, hard

lessons.title: Personal Hygiene
lessons.hook: Keeping clean helps you stay healthy and strong! Let's learn good habits! 🧼
lessons.explanation: Good hygiene means keeping your body clean and healthy. This stops germs from making us sick.
lessons.content:
Important hygiene habits:

1. **Wash Hands** 🚰 - Before eating and after bathroom (kills germs)
2. **Brush Teeth** 🪥 - Twice a day to keep them strong
3. **Take Bath** 🚿 - Wash your whole body with soap
4. **Trim Nails** 💅 - Keep them short and clean
5. **Wash Hair** 💇 - Keep scalp clean and healthy

lessons.title: Safety Rules
lessons.hook: Playing safe keeps you from getting hurt! Learn these important rules! ⚠️
lessons.explanation: Safety rules help protect us from accidents and injuries.
lessons.content:
Important safety rules:

1. **Cross Roads Safely** 🚦 - Look both ways, hold adult's hand
2. **Don't Talk to Strangers** 🚫 - Stay close to trusted adults
3. **Wear Helmet** 🪖 - When riding bike or scooter
4. **Don't Play With Fire** 🔥 - Fire is dangerous!
5. **Wear Seat Belt** 🚗 - When in a car

lessons.title: Air We Breathe
lessons.hook: You breathe air every second, but can you see it? No! But it's everywhere! 💨
lessons.explanation: Air is all around us. We can't see it, but we need it to live.
lessons.content:
Facts about air:

1. **Invisible** - We can't see air, but it's everywhere
2. **We Breathe It** 💨 - Our lungs need oxygen from air
3. **Wind** 🌪️ - Moving air is called wind
4. **Has Weight** ⚖️ - Air has weight and pushes on us
5. **Plants Need It** 🌿 - Plants use air to make food

lessons.title: Water We Need
lessons.hook: Water is everywhere! In rain, rivers, ocean - and inside you! 💧
lessons.explanation: Water is essential for all life. We can see it and it has many forms.
lessons.content:
Facts about water:

1. **Essential** 💧 - We need water to survive
2. **States** 🌡️ - Ice (solid), Water (liquid), Steam (gas)
3. **Covers Earth** 🌊 - Most of Earth is water (oceans, rivers)
4. **In Our Body** 👤 - We are mostly water
5. **Rain** 🌧️ - Water falls from clouds as rain

lessons.title: Types of Transport
lessons.hook: We use different vehicles to travel from place to place! 🚗
lessons.explanation: Transport is how we move from one place to another. There are many types.
lessons.content:
Types of transport:

1. **Land Transport** 🚗 - Car, bus, train, bicycle
2. **Water Transport** 🚢 - Boat, ship, ferry
3. **Air Transport** ✈️ - Airplane, helicopter
4. **Public Transport** 🚌 - Buses, trains, metro for many people
5. **Personal Transport** 🚲 - Bicycle, scooter, personal car

lessons.title: Ways to Communicate
lessons.hook: How do you talk to your friends and family? There are so many ways! 📱
lessons.explanation: Communication is how we share information and talk to each other.
lessons.content:
Ways to communicate:

1. **Face to Face** 👥 - Talk directly with people
2. **Phone** ☎️ - Call or text messages
3. **Letter** ✉️ - Written message sent by mail
4. **Internet** 💻 - Email, video call, chat
5. **Sign Language** 🙋 - Using hands to communicate

lessons.title: Our Planet Earth
lessons.hook: We live on a planet called Earth! It's round and very special! 🌍
lessons.explanation: Earth is our home planet. It has everything we need to survive.
lessons.content:
Facts about Earth:

1. **Round Planet** 🌍 - Earth is a sphere
2. **Has Land & Water** 🏞️ - Continents, islands, and oceans
3. **Rotates** 🌪️ - Turns to create day and night
4. **Has Atmosphere** 💨 - Air around Earth protects us
5. **Has Life** 🌿 - Plants, animals, and people live here

lessons.title: Space & Stars
lessons.hook: Beyond Earth is a huge space with stars, moon, and planets! 🌟
lessons.explanation: Space is everything beyond Earth. It's full of amazing things.
lessons.content:
Space includes:

1. **Sun** ☀️ - Star that gives us light and heat
2. **Moon** 🌙 - Orbits Earth, creates tides
3. **Stars** ⭐ - Distant suns very far away
4. **Planets** 🪐 - Orbit the sun (Mercury, Venus, Mars)
5. **Galaxy** 🌌 - Millions of stars together
